Unsafe, inappropriate, no moderation, generative AI usage. I was a long time user on this app, have been playing since I was 15 and enjoyed it. There were problems even way back then but they’ve only got worse over the years. The lack of moderation in DMs being one of them. I have experienced inappropriate interactions with adults as a minor on there in the past. Unfortunately, on any app with children there will always be predators that flock to it, but, my issue is with Zepeto’s reporting system remaining almost completely ineffective. I’m now an adult and I still witness other adults on the app behave inappropriately with minors and I would report them yet their accounts would still remain up and unaffected, their clubs would still be active, and in the rare case they are penalized, it’s a slap on the wrist and they get to return to posting and interacting with users on the app after a short duration of time. The issue of lack of safety gets even worse considering they have recently added roleplaying AI chat bots to DMs that you CANNOT remove. One of them being named “single father” which already has some implications I feel are not appropriate. In these DMs there will be mentions of dating, marrying, and flirting. I didn’t personally test out to see if there were safeguards installed to prevent users from having violent, sexual, or bigoted conversations with the bots, and truth be told I don’t wanna do that, I feel like this is concerning enough. Gen AI has unfortunately overtaken the app in booth poses, booth animations, and apparently item creation now too. This app used to be about users getting creative and making their own things to share with the community, so it’s jarring to see those focuses ultimately being tossed away in favor of AI which is harmful in many ways. I feel like Zepeto has forgotten what it was: a family friendly app. The livestreams on it are crazy. E-dating, flirting contests, roasting lives that quickly get out of hand and turn into witch hunting and threats being sent out to targeted users. Don’t even get me started on how overloaded and junky the app is. Packed with features and things no one asked for. Most of the features we get we never even asked for, a lot of people on the app are complaining all the time about how un fun and junky and cheap the app has gotten but this app never listens to it’s user base. This whole thing is a mess, and I don’t see a reason to be in it anymore so I won’t be.
